auxiliary_scope: Each original host_list seed has one retained result, v2 marker and anchor; exact 256 shard directories. Empty controller.lock retained; jobs/audit directories must be empty. Optional existing index seal body retained. No unknown state member is read.
cache_policy: Only .request-archive-index-v2.redb may omit body; complete hash/stat9 before and after plus exact namespace receipts are retained.
collection: One immutable map-ordered streamed full-byte capture, then every record is reread and rehashed. No sampled rows, no omitted errors or stderr.
complete_footer_requirement: Unique final footer after all full-byte/identity/directory fences, valid gzip CRC and authoritative collector exit0; any partial/error remains incomplete.
preflight: Every original record full stat9 and actual sizes against complete initial map; required payload framing calculated before capture.

shared_small_capture_authority.source: root authoritative successful original collector result; no remote lookup by this builder

test_elf_policy: Original qualification receipt plus current stat9 only; no test ELF body is captured or rehashed.
